events.title: Tupac Shakur's Passing
events.blurb: Commemorating the tragic passing of influential rapper Tupac Shakur in Las Vegas in 1996.

angles.name: Tupac Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the enduring impact of Tupac Shakur, whose music continues to resonate decades on. A true icon gone too soon.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix Anniversary
events.blurb: Marking the anniversary of the death of legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix in 1970.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Still unmatched: remembering the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix, who redefined what a guitar could do.

events.title: Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album in 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album
angles.copy: That zebra crossing. That album. The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' dropped in 1969, featuring some of their most beloved tracks. What's your favourite?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Celebrating the 75th birthday of The Pretenders' formidable frontwoman, Chrissie Hynde.

angles.name: Pretenders Icon
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! The Pretenders' lead singer, guitarist, and songwriter, still rocking.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Celebrating the 54th birthday of the legendary Oasis frontman, Liam Gallagher.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54! Happy Birthday to the iconic Liam Gallagher, forever a rock 'n' roll star. What's your favourite Oasis or solo track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Album
events.blurb: John Lennon's seminal solo album 'Imagine' was released in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: More than just a song, 'Imagine' the album dropped from John Lennon, with its powerful message of peace and unity still resonating today.

events.title: First iPod Release
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the original iPod in 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: Music in Your Pocket
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? It changed everything, putting '1,000 songs in your pocket' and kicking off a digital music revolution.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Celebrating the enduring legacy of the James Bond film franchise.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme songs, who's your favourite 007 and what's the best Bond tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the life and enduring musical legacy of John Lennon. Imagine.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Celebrating the 87th birthday of British comedy legend, John Cleese.

angles.name: Comedy Icon
angles.copy: He's not dead yet! Happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese. From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true master of British comedy.

events.title: The White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled 'White Album' was released in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Deep Dive
angles.copy: A sprawling masterpiece: The Beatles' 'White Album' dropped in '68, showcasing their diverse talents across 30 tracks. Which is your standout?

events.title: Freddie Mercury Anniversary
events.blurb: Marking the anniversary of the passing of Queen frontman Freddie Mercury in 1991.

angles.name: Queen's Legend
angles.copy: Remembering the incredible Freddie Mercury, who left us on this day in 1991. His voice and stage presence remain legendary.

events.title: Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Influence
angles.copy: A pivotal moment in music history: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' arrived in '65, showcasing a new depth in their songwriting and sound.
